description: This file defines the 'Geography' class, an internal utility class in Apache Spark for handling geographic data representations, including parsing and conversion methods for WKB, EWKB, WKT, and EWKT formats, as well as SRID management.

classes.name: Geography
classes.description: A final class implementing the 'Geo' interface, representing geographic data with methods for creation, copying, parsing, and format conversion.

methods.name: fromBytes
methods.description: Creates a Geography instance from a byte array.

methods.name: fromValue
methods.description: Creates a Geography instance from a GeographyVal object.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte array representation of the Geography object.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Geography instance.

methods.name: fromWkb
methods.description: Creates a Geography object from WKB data with specified SRID.

methods.name: fromWkb
methods.description: Creates a Geography object from WKB data using default SRID.

methods.description: Placeholder for EWKB parsing, not supported.

methods.name: fromWkt
methods.description: Creates a Geography object from WKT data using default SRID.

methods.name: toWkb
methods.description: Returns the WKB representation of the Geography object.
